description: Investigative true-crime podcast revealing California Bay Area corruption cases - where they ended, and what the outcome reveals about accountability.
targetAudience: Listeners interested in government accountability and the California justice system
episodeDuration: 30 minutes with one 90-second mid-roll sponsor break
commonThemes: Legal system failures allowing wealthy/connected individuals to escape consequences
Restitution used as a replacement for prison time
Public service records cited to minimize sentences for federal crimes
The Bay Area's systemic corruption across government agencies
The two-tiered justice system revealed through sentencing disparities
investigativeAngles: Why addiction narratives reduce sentences for federal crimes
How restitution can replace prison time
Sentencing disparities between institutions and individuals
producerNotes: Season 1 covers 14 cases with resolved outcomes (Episodes 1-14) plus one roundup episode (15) for cases still pending. See PROJECT_MANIFEST.json for why the other 9 of the original 24 compiled cases were excluded rather than narrated as though resolved.

linkedin.policy: Every LinkedIn post and its companion article must cite the same sources as the episode's own script.md - never state something on LinkedIn that the episode itself couldn't verify. Placeholders ([LINK], [ORG DONATION LINK], [CONTACT LINK]) must be filled in before publishing, not left live.
